<script>
  function filterPeople() {
    const roleFilter = document.getElementById('role-filter').value.toLowerCase();
    const alphaFilter = document.getElementById('alpha-filter').value.toLowerCase();

    // Loop through every section (Faculty, PhD, etc.)
    document.querySelectorAll('.people-section').forEach(section => {
      let hasVisible = false;
      
      // Loop through every person in that section
      section.querySelectorAll('.person-profile').forEach(card => {
        const role = card.getAttribute('data-role').toLowerCase();
        const lastname = card.getAttribute('data-lastname').toLowerCase();

        // Check if the person matches the selected dropdowns
        const roleMatch = (roleFilter === 'all' || role === roleFilter);
        const alphaMatch = (alphaFilter === 'all' || lastname.startsWith(alphaFilter));

        if (roleMatch && alphaMatch) {
          card.style.display = 'block';
          hasVisible = true;
        } else {
          card.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
      
      // If a section is completely empty based on the filter, hide the section header
      section.style.display = hasVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  }

  // Listen for clicks on the dropdowns
  document.getElementById('role-filter').addEventListener('change', filterPeople);
  document.getElementById('alpha-filter').addEventListener('change', filterPeople);
  
  // Run once on load to hide empty sections initially
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', filterPeople);
</script>
